name: palim
description: Cross-tool AI memory over MCP. Checkpoint chats in Cursor, resume them in Claude or ChatGPT. EU-hosted full-text search — not another local SQLite sidecar.

interface.longDescription: Save useful AI work as checkpoints, retrieve prior sessions and durable memories, and continue with the same context across ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients. Palim is EU-hosted and uses full-text and exact-text search today.
defaultPrompt: Resume my latest work from Palim.
Search Palim for my architecture decisions.
Save this decision to Palim as a checkpoint.
